exotics.name: Tractor Cannon
exotics.summary: high knockback void blast, suppress and 30% weaken for 10s, maxes move speed for 5s on hit
exotics.usage: strongest and easiest optimized debuff option, debuffs immunes unlike Fafnir, also has some small uncommon niches

exotics.name: Choir of One
exotics.summary: either ADS hitscan or hipfire spread projectile mode, has Onslaught/Destabilizing and Radiolaria Transposer variant
exotics.usage: excellent ammo economy for roam, takes exotic slot from heavies for challenges

exotics.name: Dead Messenger
exotics.summary: triple wave frame shots, element-swappable, matching effect gives 30% damage for 10s, has Demolitionist
exotics.usage: single shot damage outlier due to triple wave, has consistent damage perk too, noticeably better ammo gen than Choir

exotics.name: Gjallarhorn
exotics.summary: spawns 8 seekers on impact, gives allies same seeker effect within 15m for 15s, kills spawn extra homing rocket
exotics.usage: enables probably most potent fireteam weapon add clear strategy, buffs one of the strongest DPS options too

exotics.name: Hierarchy of Needs
exotics.summary: 3 stack deployable ring charged on crits or kills, makes 2-3 scorching seekers on every bow shot through ring, draw time buff on ring hits
exotics.usage: a bit slow and immobile for optimized roam, but enables the strongest damage strategy in the game

exotics.name: Leviathan's Breath
exotics.summary: concussive exploding arrows that apply volatile and stagger, has buffed Archer's Tempo
exotics.usage: straightforward powerful Moebius Quiver option for less optimized rotations, not great for roam otherwise

exotics.name: Still Hunt
exotics.summary: Golden Gun-esque damage mode on 6 crits or 12 orbs, has Lucky Shot
exotics.usage: still the highest swap DPS weapon in the game, excellent for minibosses too

exotics.name: Truth
exotics.summary: faster fire rate and cluster bombs after damaging with 3 rockets and reloading, aggressive tracking and detonates on proximity, has Reaper's Tithe
exotics.usage: highest non-Gjally non-Moebius heavy dump option

exotics.name: Divinity
exotics.summary: lowered damage, creates large crit spot, applies 15% weaken, and exploding cage on sustained fire, has Focused Fury and Jolting Feedback
exotics.usage: very useful on certain bosses for precision strategies

exotics.name: Ergo Sum
exotics.summary: massive perk diversity, +44% damage while Transcendent, 3 ammo on prismatic grenade hiit
exotics.usage: alternative movement tool, provides sword buff, solid add clear options

exotics.name: Fafnir
exotics.summary: consumes up to 9 ammo for 20s of 5s 30% debuff
exotics.usage: debuff very short, can't debuff immunes, but has ranged advantage over Tractor

exotics.name: Izanagi's Burden
exotics.summary: special reload sniper that can consume 4 ammo for very high damage shot
exotics.usage: swap option, also decent sustained, still one of the highest no setup crit burst roam options

exotics.name: Merciless
exotics.summary: stacking massively reduced charge time on hits, has 50% damage perk on kill-reload
exotics.usage: very good no setup miniboss melt option due to Particle

exotics.name: One Thousand Voices
exotics.summary: delayed scorching explosive bolts, DoT Taken seeker on explosions, 2x tick damage if Witherhoarded
exotics.usage: extremely easy damage option, arguably not worth it given surrounding alternatives but still decent

exotics.name: Parasite
exotics.summary: 20 stack rank-dependent kill counter, up to 3x damage, self-damage gives 15% damage to other weapons for 10s, has Envious Arsenal
exotics.usage: 15% non-power boost is less relevant now, but still has some use cases

exotics.name: Praxic Blade
exotics.summary: extremely versatile multi-mode sword with insane ammo economy and variable catalysts
exotics.usage: Hyperblade used for movement, insanely consistent neutral option despite not being very optimal

exotics.name: Alethonym
exotics.summary: stackable micro-missile GL that gets ammo creation charges via pickups
exotics.usage: primary movement tool, slow guaranteed ammo gen, fast grapple option

exotics.name: Anarchy
exotics.summary: 6 linkable stickable traps that tick between them and explode on expiry, has Jolting Feedback and Impromptu Ammunition
exotics.usage: BiS total tick option for sustained special damage, also good for trapping doors

exotics.name: Bastion
exotics.summary: pellet fusion that gives +300% melee damage on hits, also has Trench Barrel-esque buff, has Cast No Shadows
exotics.usage: decent sustained option, decent for roam, has exclusive high 12P variant for melee strategies

exotics.name: D.A.R.C.I.
exotics.summary: shows HP amounts, jolts, and stacks damage buff on long ADS crits, also gives teammates stacking legendary sniper 15.9% buff
exotics.usage: nowhere near as beneficial vs. Gjally for rockets, but still useful for large fireteam sniper DPS

exotics.name: Edge of Action
exotics.summary: 3 projectile or 6 melee hits charge alt fire deployable bubble, gives 45 HP Void OS and 5% stackable weapon damage for 10s on dip
exotics.usage: 5% stackable is nice, especially given swap potential, not a bad defensive tool either

exotics.name: Euphony
exotics.summary: adaptive burst linear that spawns 3 threadlings on 2 bursts, has up to 50% damage after 25 threadling hits
exotics.usage: good sustained special damage with Pack Tactics

exotics.name: Heirloom
exotics.summary: explosive bolts, heat generated by ADSing, 3 stage charge that increases damage and scorch stacks, has Incandescent
exotics.usage: surprisingly excellent splash damage per shot, DoT option for Envious, just has long charge time

exotics.name: Tessellation
exotics.summary: enhanced Demo and Transcendence gains, consumes grenade to create explosive projectile with secondary splash effect
exotics.usage: best in class instant splash miniboss killer in speedrunning, also decent boss burst

exotics.name: The Fourth Horseman
exotics.summary: increasing successive shot damage, refills ammo based on rank of killed enemy
exotics.usage: very easy instant miniboss burst, usable for damage as well

exotics.name: Turncoat
exotics.summary: EP every 3 shots, meter charged on hits/kills, consume to give fire rate, infinite ammo/EP, weaken, transferable stackable buff
exotics.usage: usable for roam due to artifact, otherwise situationally useful for extremely optimized rocket dumping

exotics.name: Wavesplitter
exotics.summary: cycles power on sustained fire, orb pickup gives max power for 10s and refills, suppresses on 12 max power hits, has AO + Detonator Beam
exotics.usage: probably the best exotic add clear trace in artifact context

exotics.name: Ager's Scepter
exotics.summary: instant splash freeze + refill on kill, has super drain mode that does decent DPS
exotics.usage: decent add clear but not anything worth exotic slot, only use is best low power add clear trace

exotics.name: Arbalest
exotics.summary: guaranteed shield break of any type, Disruption Break
exotics.usage: completely powercrept stun-wise, useful for guaranteed boss-level shield break

exotics.name: Buried Bloodline
exotics.summary: twin tracking bolts, 11 HP on hit, Devour on 4 minor / 1 elite+ kill, weaken on hit with Devour
exotics.usage: only non-artifact/subclass source of Devour besides RoN 4pc. for challenges

exotics.name: Collective Obligation
exotics.summary: stores void debuffs from targets or makes them every 27 hits, alt fire to apply debuffs and +20% damage, refill on void buffs, has Repulsor Brace
exotics.usage: excellent with void artifact

exotics.name: Cull's Shadow
exotics.summary: aggressive fusion with blades that take melee buffs, applies DoT via shots after 2 melees, ticked enemies make crystals on death
exotics.usage: tick option for Envious, melee stacking neutral is decent

exotics.name: Delicate Tomb
exotics.summary: 16 bolt burst, 20% damage on hipfire, Ionic Trace chance on kill (guaranteed if elite+), 2x damage jolting shot and 4 ammo refill on trace pickup
exotics.usage: better instant Ionic Trace source than Coldheart, worse ammo economy though

exotics.name: Dragon's Breath
exotics.summary: refills on 2 ignitions, damage and longer embed based on stacks, spawns Firesprites on kill and bypasses cooldown
exotics.usage: underrated swap DPS option, has unique Firesprite bypass use case

exotics.name: Finality's Auger
exotics.summary: alt fire deployable turret that can paint targets to deal more damage, has regular LFR mode, has Bait and Switch
exotics.usage: outclassed by Anarchy, better super generation but not relevant any more, can be placed inside doors

exotics.name: Graviton Lance
exotics.summary: chaining void explosion and seeker orbs on kill, has Turnabout
exotics.usage: pretty strong with artiifact, more lethal but less debuff-focused Collective Obligation competitor

exotics.name: Ice Breaker
exotics.summary: custom sniper frame, generates ammo from non-Ice Breaker kills or stasis-debuffed hits, ignition on crit or frozen shatter
exotics.usage: ammo mechanic can be situationally useful, also can pair with stasis builds

exotics.name: Khvostov 7G-0X
exotics.summary: ricocheting auto, orbs give 7 enhanced ricocheting bullets that bounce 7 times, has Shoot to Loot + Attrition Orbs
exotics.usage: great for contest-like environments for spreading assist credit and getting ammo, also generally potent in solos

exotics.name: Legend of Acrius
exotics.summary: massive spread overpenetrating pellets, has a grounded damage instance, has Trench Barrel
exotics.usage: simple and consistent melee damage option, similar to high tier swords

exotics.name: Necrochasm
exotics.summary: chainable cursed thrall explosion on crit kill, fire rate buff on crit kill-reload or splash kill, refreshable OFA variant
exotics.usage: surprisingly high QoL kinetic add clear option, less artifact synergy but still pretty strong

exotics.name: New Malpais
exotics.summary: 3 shot sticky burst, embedded stickies unravel and explode via special reload, suspend blast on 2 burst detonation
exotics.usage: stickies are useful for activating on-hit objectives from range or simultaneously

exotics.name: Prometheus Lens
exotics.summary: scorching field on sustained damage, 75 ammo refill on kill, has Incandescent
exotics.usage: besides unique ammo gen, certainly not the strongest exotic add clear trace

exotics.name: Salvation's Grip
exotics.summary: charged shots shoot crystal formation, uncharged shots break crystals, 25% damage to frozen enemies, has Rimestealer
exotics.usage: only useful for DSM and terrain generation requirements in challenges

exotics.name: The Lament
exotics.summary: 7HP on damage tick (includes scorch), special blocking revving mechanic that amps damage, has Burning Ambition
exotics.usage: higher QoL but worse damage version of Wolfsbane

exotics.name: The Navigator
exotics.summary: 8 ally hits gives 60 HP, regen, and Woven Mail to both parties, Woven Mail + sever on 20 enemy hits, grapple tangle special reload
exotics.usage: only relevant for Woven Mail applications (limited beyond contest) and grapple melee bosses (almost none)

exotics.name: Trinity Ghoul
exotics.summary: 3 split arrows, arc kills give next shot chain lightning
exotics.usage: scales very poorly into low power content, but still has some use for easy spread chained add clear

exotics.name: Vex Mythoclast
exotics.summary: fusion interactions, 6 kills (T3+ doubled) for crit kill igniting LFR mode, 20% damage for 5s on sustained fire or kill, has Rewind Rounds variant
exotics.usage: easily best single target primary ever produced in sandbox context, but niche in endgame is still small

exotics.name: Vexcalibur
exotics.summary: special 5 bolt spread, +25% projectile damage to Vex, blocking gives Void OS to allies within 15m, glaive melee kills give full OS while OS is active
exotics.usage: underrated, probably best purely defensive exotic, just struggles to activate overshield refresh in low power

exotics.name: Whirling Ovation
exotics.summary: time-scaled strand/solar damage that charges faster as damage is done with other weapons, solar grenade on minor/elite pierce
exotics.usage: already struggled to differentiate itself from Parasite during rocket pulse meta, maybe useful for some optimized finals

exotics.name: Wolfsbane
exotics.summary: charges meter on hits and kills, can consume to activate overclocked mode with scorching cyclones, has variable catalysts
exotics.usage: most relevant melee range easy sustained damage option

exotics.name: Bad Juju
exotics.summary: hugely increased super generation on stacking kill perk, also has cursed thrall explosion on 3 kills
exotics.usage: super generation niche surpassed by artifact setup, add clear profile underrated though

exotics.name: Cerberus+1
exotics.summary: pellet auto with 50% damage perk on special kill-reload
exotics.usage: basically just for breaking crystals and maybe Calus skulls

exotics.name: Cloudstrike
exotics.summary: Bolt Charge (x5 on kill) and lightning strike on 3 crits or crit kill, has Triple Tap
exotics.usage: outclassed by legendary snipers, lightning strike is used in just RoN 3rd

exotics.name: Coldheart
exotics.summary: sustained damage and Ionic Traces give energy, spawns Ionic Trace every 2s at max energy, has Supercharged Magazine
exotics.usage: best sustained Ionic Trace source in the game, however not the most applicable use case

exotics.name: Conditional Finality
exotics.summary: stasis/solar 2 mag shotgun that freezes and ignites with respective shots
exotics.usage: good chunks and high QoL for roam, but no crazy outlier behavior for endgame

exotics.name: Duality
exotics.summary: pellet kill or most pellets hit stack 3x up to 54.7% slug crit damage for 10.5s, slug crits refresh duration
exotics.usage: very solid sustained DPS for a special but nothing standout

exotics.name: Eriana's Vow
exotics.summary: 32.5% damage on first scoped shot, buff disappears after body shot, ignition on matching or champion shield break, has ALH
exotics.usage: good for killing individual potentially shielded enemies, otherwise useless

exotics.name: Ex Diris
exotics.summary: scaling fire rate increase on hits (maxed on crit health), spawns moth on 2 hits (3s ICD), Amplified on kill
exotics.usage: weapon-based Amplified, can be used to die, add clear and damage aren't good

exotics.name: Eyes of Tomorrow
exotics.summary: 6 individually tracking rockets, 4 kills with one volley gives 50% damage buff and 1 ammo refund, has Demolitionist and Blast Distributor
exotics.usage: slow but technically has infinite ammo power-level add clear

exotics.name: Fighting Lion
exotics.summary: volatile burst on hit, refill on non-Fighting Lion kill within 6s of dealing damage
exotics.usage: usable for certain builds due to artifact (void/Weakened Clear)

exotics.name: Final Warning
exotics.summary: tracking/hitscan hybrid sidearm that can mark enemies to do 2x crit damage and fully charge to unravel
exotics.usage: in theory a strong damage profile but a little unwieldy to use

exotics.name: Forerunner
exotics.summary: insane crit multi special sidearm, has special kill-reload that replaces grenade with frag that scales with grenade buffs
exotics.usage: The Rock has crazy scaling with grenade buffs but otherwise not relevant for add clear

exotics.name: Grand Overture
exotics.summary: slug launcher that loads up to 20 blinding missiles on hit that explode on kill, alt fire to change modes and fire missile burst
exotics.usage: outdated damage, total not even that impressive, too slow for add clear

exotics.name: Heartshadow
exotics.summary: weaken on hit, 25% damage, and move speed while invisible, invisibility on grounded powered heavy
exotics.usage: niche debuff extension option for sword damage, otherwise not very useful

exotics.name: Le Monarque
exotics.summary: fully drawn crits leave fast ticking poison, has Unrelenting
exotics.usage: only notable due to Storm's Keep interaction

exotics.name: Lord of Wolves
exotics.summary: 5 shot bursts, hipfire causes scorching shots, ADS causes scorching explosion on kill
exotics.usage: completely outclassed by both legendary and exotic special alternatives, unique ammo gen stat

exotics.name: Lumina
exotics.summary: 2 Noble Rounds on kill, hipfire to give 35% damage buff and 100 Class to wielder and ally for 11s
exotics.usage: grappling eclipsed by Alethonym and rockets, damage buff succeeded by Boots of the Assembler

exotics.name: Microcosm
exotics.summary: huge bonus to shields, refill and 20% damage for 20s on super, has Thresh and rank-dependent buffed super gains
exotics.usage: shield health use case is extremely rare and Arbalest exists, damage profile is awful

exotics.name: Monte Carlo
exotics.summary: 2% melee on hit, 25% chance to give full melee on kill, 65% Swashbuckler-type damage perk, has buffable special reload bayonet
exotics.usage: tempo too slow compared to other melee synergy exotics

exotics.name: New Land Beyond
exotics.summary: bolt-action sniper that scales to +73% damage on crits, fire rate scales with reload buffs, infinitely fires beyond 20 stacks
exotics.usage: legendary version exists in energy slot, excellent ammo economy but struggles to find niche

exotics.name: Osteo Striga
exotics.summary: tracking projectiles, 7 crits or 14 hits within 3s or kill makes poison burst, poison kills refill mag and can overflow to 4x mag
exotics.usage: decent add clear option but nothing special, lacks artifact synergy too

exotics.name: Rat King
exotics.summary: regen start and invis for 5.8s on kill-reload, massive fire rate and mag increase scaling with nearby allies using Rat King
exotics.usage: subclass-independent guaranteed invisibility method, otherwise pretty bad

exotics.name: Red Death Reformed
exotics.summary: Cure x2 on kill, Cure x1 to allies on kill-reload, scaling damage as HP gets lower, healing orb on 3 weapon kill counter
exotics.usage: held back by frame, great survivability but poor lethality, doesn't really fit current endgame playstyle

exotics.name: Riskrunner
exotics.summary: 50% arc resist and chain lightning on incoming arc damage, has Chain Reaction
exotics.usage: Arc shield is sometimes useful for certain solos, otherwise Arc Conductor trigger requirement too situational

exotics.name: Service of Luzaku
exotics.summary: support frame mechanics, threadling-spawning nests on kills, can be healed, harvestable after 6 threadlings spawned
exotics.usage: only relic droppable interact, otherwise waste of exotic heavy slot

exotics.name: Skyburner's Oath
exotics.summary: scorching hipfire projectiles, has Incandescent and Burning Ambition, +11% damage to Cabal
exotics.usage: solid laid-back ignition spam option, but very slow playstyle

exotics.name: Slayer's Fang

exotics.name: Witherhoard

exotics.name: Worldline Zero

exotics.name: Xenophage

exotics.name: Ace of Spades

exotics.name: Crimson

exotics.name: Cryosthesia 77K

exotics.usage: freeze shot no longer relevant for challenges given prominence of freeze options

exotics.name: Dead Man's Tale

exotics.usage: held back by frame, single target nature, not that special

exotics.name: Deathbringer

exotics.usage: outclassed in boss DPS and for add clear

exotics.name: Hard Light

exotics.name: Hawkmoon

exotics.usage: similar situation to Dead Man's Tale

exotics.name: Jötunn

exotics.name: No Time to Explain

exotics.name: Polaris Lance
exotics.summary: scorching solar round after 4 crits, refunds shot if crit, has Dragonfly

exotics.name: The Last Word

exotics.name: The Prospector
